title: Thai Chicken Satay Sandwich with Peanut Sauce
summary: Chicken satay, peanut sauce and a red-cabbage, cucumber and coriander salad on toasted sourdough. The Swedish description supplies the ingredient quantities; video playback and transcript retrieval were blocked, so the cooking method is not yet captured.
serves: Approximately 2 large sandwiches or 4 smaller sandwiches

notes: First Swedish-language source added under Axel's 2026-11-02 request. The Recipe Bank entry is in English; the original Swedish ingredient list is preserved separately in vault evidence.

The public description provides measurements and the batch yield but does not give a complete cooking method. Partial status reflects capture access limits, not a claim that the creator withheld the method or put it behind a paywall.
Swedish msk and tsk are translated as tbsp and tsp; decimal comma 1,5 becomes 1.5, while decilitres remain decilitres. No unprovided quantities or nutrition values are calculated.
The chicken and sauce have separate coconut-milk and soy-sauce amounts; the salad and sauce each have their own half-lime allocation. Do not duplicate or merge these allocations silently.
